scope: Only decomposition and paired-log-ratio implementation and interpretation; no original-primary-model modification

findings.detail: Explicit oral-form filter gives2200cells/58presentations and agrees with the ddd-not-null source selection;57common,0entrants,1exit. Different22/18-month periods are pooled by prescription items as declared.
Two-order counterfactual-weight calculation independently reproduces within,composition,entry and exit contributions. The net period ratio difference is exactly recovered.

Modelling log(DDD/items) uses same-month paired data and captures numerator-denominator covariance. exp(Lbeta)-1 is a ratio change relative to continued pre-break log-ratio trend; it is not a difference between the frozen separately fitted GLS percentages or a formal retest of them.
OLS point estimates, Bartlett Newey-West covariance with n/(n-p), residualdf25 and t intervals were independently matched using statsmodels OLS robust-results t_test for lag3 and both breakpoints.

Only40months/15coefficients. HAC changes covariance, not fitted mean; lag sensitivity does not prove adequate finite-sample interval coverage. February DDD/item lag1 ACF is approximately0.699 (lag2≈0.425), and DDD/row lag1≈0.604. These must remain limitations, not be described as resolved by HAC.

November DDD/item +7.50%(2.95,12.24) versus February +0.95%(-7.10,9.70) limits attribution to the November alert or packaging policy. A nonsignificant February result is not equivalence and does not refute descriptive period decomposition.

DDD/row is algebraically related to DDD/item and items/row, so the three ratios are not independent replications. November items/row interval changes from spanning0 at lag3 to just above0 at lag6; do not select the lag6 result as confirmation.

94.92% is the share of an exact observed pooled-period net change accounted for by the within-BNF-presentation term, not a causal attributable fraction, person-level dose change, proportion of patients, or estimated policy effect. No sampling CI is attached to this finite aggregate identity. Share percentages depend on chosen periods/aggregation, and components can exceed100% or be negative in other datasets.

Raw pre/post DDD/item increases8.90%; modelled terminal ratio difference7.50% has a different denominator and time-trend comparison. Do not label the former as an ITS effect or claim the two estimates independently validate each other.

Within means the same BNFpresentation code, potentially combining practices and underlying dispensing circumstances. Entrants/exits may be coding changes. Check any code-to-strength changes before attributing within movement to pack size or repeat dispensing.

recommended_integration: Use DDD/item as the clinically interpretable exploratory ratio; give February sensitivity alongside November. Keep rows-related ratios as supporting measurement diagnostics, preserve all executed results in supplement. Describe within-presentation94.9% as arithmetic decomposition only. No added significance tests are required to claim the finite sum identity.
